QUOTE: Direct llama.cpp usage lives in `src/inference/`: `llama_cpp_backend.{h,cpp}`, `llama_cpp_sampler.{h,cpp}`, `llama_cpp_tokenizer.{h,cpp}`, plus `adapter_manager.cpp` (LoRA) and `image_preprocessor.cpp`
